text: Attempted the quiet JDK21 side-1024 rerun after one-minute load fell near 6. Extrema began clean, but scalar Int product then spiked from ~150 us to 0.86-9.81 ms mid-fork and load returned above 9. Canceled the owned JMH session at 50 percent; removed its zero-byte output. No partial row is admitted as evidence. Generalized the physical-density invariant to exact fixed-width full reductions and full Double extrema across arbitrary ranks; focused JVM and Scala.js layout/reduction suites pass 22/22 each, and a four-layout rank-3 JMH witness compiles pending a quiet host.
